page_404_body: The link may be wrong or the page has moved. All current reports are on the map.
page_410_title: This report is no longer available
page_410_body: The report has been closed or removed. The animal may already be home.
page_500_title: Something went wrong on our side
page_500_body: We are already working on it. Please try again in a few minutes. Your drafts are saved on this device.
offline_body: When you are back online, the page will reload by itself. Drafts stay saved.
VALIDATION: Some details are missing or not quite right. Please check the highlighted fields.
AAL2_REQUIRED: This needs two-step verification. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
NOT_FOUND: We cannot find this any more. It may have been removed.
GONE: This report is closed, so it can no longer be changed.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this. If you think this is a mistake, sign in with another account.
UNVERIFIED_EMAIL: Please confirm your email address first. We have emailed you a link.
RATE_LIMITED: Several requests were sent in a short time. Please try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
RATE_LIMITED_generic: Several requests were sent in a short time. Please try again a little later.
CAPTCHA_FAILED: We could not confirm that this is you and not a bot. Please try again.
CONFLICT: Something changed in the meantime. Please refresh and try again.
DUPLICATE_OPEN_REPORT: You already have an open search for this animal. You can update it.
LIVE_MODE_FORBIDDEN: Payments in this version are test payments only.
INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.
NETWORK: The connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.
UPLOAD_TYPE: This file is not a photo. Please choose a JPG, PNG or HEIC image.
UPLOAD_SIZE: The photo is too large. Choose another one or make it smaller first.
